resources.string: Checking the local connection prepared by the installer…
Preparing offline speech. Keep this window open…
Connecting the supported controls and waiting for their responses…

The local connection, speech model, microphone permission, button service and enabled handlers are ready. Try the microphone when parked. Physical actions and the next cold boot still require a device check.

The app connection and offline speech model are ready. This exact firmware has no verified vehicle profile, so vehicle controls remain unavailable. Check the microphone and Accessibility settings in Controls.
The supported handlers responded. Allow microphone access and enable Controls in Accessibility settings before using voice and assigned buttons.
Setup did not finish. Resume from the Windows installer.
The app could not confirm local root access. Resume Prepare and install in the Windows installer; check its connection and startup diagnostics.
The offline speech model could not be prepared. Check free space, then reinstall a complete APK without clearing app data.
Free at least 128 MiB of internal storage before preparing offline speech, then retry setup. Existing settings and speech models are kept.
The vehicle handlers did not confirm readiness. Open Controls to inspect connection status; keep the PC backup for recovery.
Assign a tap action before saving a hold action.

Assign a tap action before adding a hold action. If a target is unavailable, the key keeps its stock behavior. Hold-only mappings use the stock action here; use the supported OEM controls for separate gestures.
